outcome: infants born small for gestational age
cohort: 110 pregnant women with NAFLD and a control group of 1,960,416 women without NAFLD from the Swedish Medical Birth Register (1992-2011)
finding: Women with NAFLD had increased risks for gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia, cesarean section, preterm birth, and low birth weight, independent of BMI and diabetes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in women with NAFLD compared to controls.
